```{r}
treat <- rep(c("F1","F2","F3","F4"), each = 4)

# treat <- rep(1:4, each=4)
gain  <- c(18.4, 19.2, 17.8, 18.6,
           22.3, 21.5, 22.8, 22.0,
           16.5, 17.2, 16.8, 17.5,
           24.1, 23.5, 24.6, 23.8)

df <- data.frame(treat, gain)
```



---


```{r}
boxplot(gain ~ treat, data = df,
        col = "#dbeafe", border = "#2563eb",
        xlab = "Factors", ylab = "Gain",
        main = "Gain vs Factors")
```



```{r}
a <- 4;  n <- 4;  N <- a * n

CF <- sum(gain)^2 / N
SST <- sum(gain^2) - CF

treat_sum <- tapply(gain, df$treat, sum)
SS_treat <- sum(treat_sum^2) / n - CF
SSE <- SST - SS_treat

df_treat <- a - 1          # 3
df_error <- N - a          # 16

MS_treat <- SS_treat / df_treat
MSE      <- SSE      / df_error
F_calc   <- MS_treat / MSE
F_tab    <- qf(0.95, df_treat, df_error)

c(SS_treat = SS_treat, SSE = SSE,
        MS_treat = MS_treat, MSE = MSE,
        F_calc = F_calc, F_tab = F_tab)
```

```{r}
model <- aov(gain ~ treat, data = df)
summary(model)
```

```{r}
treat1 <- rep(c("F1","F2","F3","F4"), each = 4)

treat2 <- rep(1:4, each=4)
gain  <- c(18.4, 19.2, 17.8, 18.6,
           22.3, 21.5, 22.8, 22.0,
           16.5, 17.2, 16.8, 17.5,
           24.1, 23.5, 24.6, 23.8)

df1 <- data.frame(treat1, gain)
df2 <- data.frame(treat2, gain)

model1 <- aov(gain ~ treat1, data = df1)
model2 <- aov(gain ~ treat2, data = df2)

summary(model1)
summary(model2)


plot(model1)
```
```{r}
res <- residuals(model)
fit <- fitted(model)
fit
res

qqnorm(res, pch=20)
plot(fit, res)

# should know sequence of treatments
plot(seq_along(res), res)
```
